pairs.target: dìèrtiān rùyè yǐqián , huòchǎng zuìhòu yìzhī kōng xiāng sòngzǒu , jiēhuò fángmén shàng de suǒ luò le xiàlái .
pairs.english: Before nightfall the next day, the freight yard sent off its last empty carriage and the receiving office was locked.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天入夜以前，货场最后一只空厢送走，接货房门上的锁落了下来。

pairs.target: jiēkǒu què bǐ báitiān gèng xiǎng , yǒurén jiāng dēng guàdào cháng zhúgān shàng , jǐjiā píngrì mài shéng yóu de pùzi shōuqǐ ménbǎn , bǎi chū de búshì shéng yóu , shì tián zhōu , zhēnggāo hé yìpén pén xǐjìng de qīngguǒ .
pairs.english: The street corner was louder than by day. People hung lamps on long bamboo poles, and shops normally selling rope oil put away their shutters, setting out sweet porridge, steamed cakes and basins of washed green fruit instead of rope oil.
pairs.hanzi: 街口却比白天更响，有人将灯挂到长竹杆上，几家平日卖绳油的铺子收起门板，摆出的不是绳油，是甜粥、蒸糕和一盆盆洗净的青果。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng kǎobǐng pù xiàlóu , běnlái zhī xiǎng mǎi yìwǎn miàn .
pairs.english: Tavi came downstairs from the bakery, intending only to buy a bowl of noodles.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从烤饼铺下楼，本来只想买一碗面。

pairs.target: xià róng zài jiē duìmiàn jiào tā , tóufa chóngxīn shù guò , bèishàng méi dài zhúlǒu , shǒulǐ qiān zhe yígè bǐ tā ǎi bàntóu de gūniáng .
pairs.english: Xiarong called from across the street, her hair freshly tied, no basket on her back, leading a girl half a head shorter by the hand.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒在街对面叫他，头发重新束过，背上没带竹篓，手里牵着一个比她矮半头的姑娘。

pairs.target: nà shì tā biǎomèi , yí jiàn tǎ wéi biàn wèn shìbushì xià róng shuō de nàwèi jiāng hóngqí jì chéngfēng de rén .
pairs.english: It was her younger cousin, who immediately asked if Tavi was the person Xiarong had mentioned who recorded the red flag as wind.
pairs.hanzi: 那是她表妹，一见塔维便问是不是夏绒说的那位将红旗记成风的人。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , yùbèi ràng rén xiào yìhuí , biǎomèi quèshuō zìjǐ diē yě zhème jiǎng guò , wàidìrén shígè yǒu bāgè huì rèncuò , wèn xià róng wèihé piān ná tā de shì huíjiā jiǎng .
pairs.english: He nodded, ready to be laughed at, but the cousin said her father said the same: eight out of ten outsiders got it wrong. Why had Xiarong chosen his story to tell at home?
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，预备让人笑一回，表妹却说自己爹也这么讲过，外地人十个有八个会认错，问夏绒为何偏拿他的事回家讲。

pairs.target: xià róng shēnshǒu jiāng tā tuīxiàng gāo tān , jiào tā mǎi zìjǐ de , bié bǎ jīnwǎn shuōhuà de fèn yě suàn jìn sānkuài gāo lǐ .
pairs.english: Xiarong steered her toward the cake stall and told her to buy her own, not count tonight's speaking allowance among three cakes too.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒伸手将她推向糕摊，叫她买自己的，别把今晚说话的份也算进三块糕里。

pairs.target: tāmen búshì tèyì lái zhǎo tā , qiánmiàn háiyǒu jǐgè shúrén děng zhe . xià róng wèn tā yào buyào yìqǐ , tā biàn jiāng miàn tān de wèizhì jìzhù , gēnzhe zǒu .
pairs.english: They had not come specially for him; several friends were waiting ahead. Xiarong asked whether he would join them, so he noted the noodle stall's location and followed.
pairs.hanzi: 她们不是特意来找他，前面还有几个熟人等着。夏绒问他要不要一起，他便将面摊的位置记住，跟着走。

pairs.target: jiēmiàn cóng báitiān yùnhuò de nàtiáo lù , hūrán biànchéng kěyǐ zhàn zhe bù zǒu de dìfāng , rén jǐ zài yìqǐ , yě méi rén lìkè chuīshào cuī kāi .
pairs.english: The daytime freight road suddenly became somewhere people could stand still, crowded together without anyone immediately whistling them apart.
pairs.hanzi: 街面从白天运货的那条路，忽然变成可以站着不走的地方，人挤在一起，也没人立刻吹哨催开。

pairs.target: yíchù kòngdì shàng shù zhe xiǎo mù quān , quān xuán zài hénggān xià , bèi fēng tuī dé láihuí bǎi . huā yìdiǎn qián néng huàn sānméi biǎn mùpiàn , tóujìnqù biàn ná yíkuài dòugāo .
pairs.english: A little wooden hoop hung beneath a crossbar in an open space, swaying in the wind. A small payment bought three flat wooden tokens; a successful throw earned a bean cake.
pairs.hanzi: 一处空地上竖着小木圈，圈悬在横杆下，被风推得来回摆。花一点钱能换三枚扁木片，投进去便拿一块豆糕。

pairs.target: biǎomèi xiān tóu , yìméi tiēbiān , yìméi diào dì , zuìhòu yìméi què zhèng chuān guòqù , tā cháo xià róng jǔ gāo , xiàng nádào yìfēng shuí yě bùnéng bóhuí de wěituō .
pairs.english: The cousin went first: one grazed the edge, one fell, and the last sailed through. She raised her cake toward Xiarong like a commission nobody could reject.
pairs.hanzi: 表妹先投，一枚贴边，一枚掉地，最后一枚却正穿过去，她朝夏绒举糕，像拿到一封谁也不能驳回的委托。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò mùpiàn , xiān kàn fēng , zài kàn quān , juéde zhī chà yíduàn héshì de jùlí .
pairs.english: Tavi took the tokens, checked the wind first and then the hoop, thinking all he needed was the right distance.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过木片，先看风，再看圈，觉得只差一段合适的距离。

pairs.target: dìyīméi cóng quān xià fēiguò , dìèrméi zhèng dǎ zài mù quān shàng , tánhuí zìjǐ jiǎo biān , dìsānméi chūshǒu tài chí , quān yǐjīng piān guòqù , lián biān dōu méi pèng zhe .
pairs.english: The first flew below, the second hit the hoop and bounced back at his feet, and the third left his hand too late, missing even the edge as the hoop had already swung away.
pairs.hanzi: 第一枚从圈下飞过，第二枚正打在木圈上，弹回自己脚边，第三枚出手太迟，圈已经偏过去，连边都没碰着。

pairs.target: xià róng xiào dé wān xiàyāo , tā biàn bǎ dìshàng de nà méi jiǎnqǐlái dì hái tānzhǔ , wèn néng bunéng jièzhe zài kàn yìhuí biérén zěnme tóu .
pairs.english: Xiarong doubled over laughing. He picked up the token from the ground and returned it to the stallholder, asking if he could stay to watch how others threw.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒笑得弯下腰，他便把地上的那枚捡起来递还摊主，问能不能借着再看一回别人怎么投。

pairs.target: tānzhǔ jiào tā bié kàn zìjǐ , zhī kàn xiǎohái , zuìxiǎo de nàge yǐjīng yíng zǒu liǎngkuài gāo , zìjǐ jīnrì zài jiào rén , dàgài dé bǎ wǎnfàn yě shūguāng .
pairs.english: The stallholder told him to watch the children instead of him. The youngest had won two cakes already; if he taught anyone else today, he might lose his dinner too.
pairs.hanzi: 摊主叫他别看自己，只看小孩，最小的那个已经赢走两块糕，自己今日再教人，大概得把晚饭也输光。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài biānshàng kàn , hòulái búzài shùquān měi huí yáo jǐxià , zhī děng tā zhuǎn dào zìjǐ zuì róngyì sòng jìn de nàge wèizhì .
pairs.english: He watched from the side, eventually stopping counting the swings and simply waiting for the hoop to reach the position easiest for his throw.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在边上看，后来不再数圈每回摇几下，只等它转到自己最容易送进的那个位置。

pairs.target: zài huā yífèn qián , zhèhuí zhōng le . gāo bǐ xiǎng de báo , tā bāi chéng liǎngbàn , yíbàn gěi xià róng , tā yòu fēngěi gānghǎo huílái de biǎomèi , sāngè rén zhàn zhe chī wán , shuí yě méi bǎo .
pairs.english: He paid again and scored this time. The cake was thinner than expected. He broke it in half and gave half to Xiarong, who shared with her returning cousin; all three finished it standing, none full.
pairs.hanzi: 再花一份钱，这回中了。糕比想的薄，他掰成两半，一半给夏绒，她又分给刚好回来的表妹，三个人站着吃完，谁也没饱。

pairs.target: jiē de lìngyìtóu yǒurén chuī qǐ chángcháng yìshēng , tǎ wéi hái yǐwéi huòchǎng chū liǎo shì , zhuǎntóu què kànjiàn dù chéng zuòzài ǎiqiáng shàng , shǒulǐ niē zhe yìzhī duǎn wěi guǎn .
pairs.english: A long note sounded at the other end of the street. Tavi thought something had happened at the freight yard, then turned to see Du Cheng sitting on a low wall with a short reed pipe in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 街的另一头有人吹起长长一声，塔维还以为货场出了事，转头却看见杜澄坐在矮墙上，手里捏着一支短苇管。

pairs.target: pángbiān liǎnggè rén qiāo mùbǎn , qǐchū xiàngshì xièhuò shí de jiépāi , hūrán yí kuài , wéizhe de rén jiù xiào zhe pāishǒu , jǐgè xiǎohái gēnzhe luàn duòjiǎo .
pairs.english: Two people beside him tapped boards, at first like the rhythm of unloading, then suddenly faster. People gathered around laughed and clapped while children stamped haphazardly along.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边两个人敲木板，起初像是卸货时的节拍，忽然一快，围着的人就笑着拍手，几个小孩跟着乱跺脚。

pairs.target: dù chéng kànjiàn tā , méi tíng , chuī guò yíduàn cái wèn jīnrì yǒuméiyǒu bǎ zhège yě xiě jìn děnghòu shíkè . tǎ wéi shuō méiyǒu , děng tā xiǎng hǎo fàngzài nǎ yìlán .
pairs.english: Du Cheng saw him but kept playing, only afterward asking whether he had recorded this among the waiting times too. Tavi said not yet, he was deciding which column it belonged in.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄看见他，没停，吹过一段才问今日有没有把这个也写进等候时刻。塔维说没有，等他想好放在哪一栏。

pairs.target: huōyá bān gōng zài pángbiān hēng le yìshēng , shuō yào xiě biàn bǎ dù chéng qùnián chuīpò de nà zhī yě suàn shàng , qián shì dàjiā còu de , búshì tā de sī zhàng .
pairs.english: The gap-toothed porter snorted nearby and said he should count the pipe Du Cheng had broken last year too: everyone had paid toward it, not his private funds.
pairs.hanzi: 豁牙搬工在旁边哼了一声，说要写便把杜澄去年吹破的那支也算上，钱是大家凑的，不是他的私账。

pairs.target: liǎng rén yòu wèi shuí xiān bǎ wěi guǎn fàngzài rè lúbiān zhēng le jǐjù , qǔzi qǐlái shí què dōu jiē dé shàng .
pairs.english: They argued over who had left the reed pipe by the hot stove first, but both came in on cue when the tune began.
pairs.hanzi: 两人又为谁先把苇管放在热炉边争了几句，曲子起来时却都接得上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài rénqún lǐ , tīngjiàn xià róng zài lìngyìbiān hé shúrén shuōhuà , zìjǐ búyòng jiē měi yíjù , yě búyòng děng shuí lái tì zìjǐ jièshào , jiànjiàn biàn tīng qīng le nàduàn fǎnfù de diàozi .
pairs.english: Tavi stood in the crowd, hearing Xiarong talk with friends elsewhere. He did not have to answer every sentence or wait to be introduced, and gradually heard the repeating melody clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在人群里，听见夏绒在另一边和熟人说话，自己不用接每一句，也不用等谁来替自己介绍，渐渐便听清了那段反复的调子。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng lái zhǎo tā chī miàn shí , wēn xiù yě zài , shǒulǐ līn zhe liǎngchuàn kǎo wù , nǎbiān chī dào yíbàn yě fēnbùqīng .
pairs.english: When Ruan Heng came to fetch him for noodles, Wenxiu was there too, carrying two skewers of roasted food, with no telling which was half eaten.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡来找他吃面时，温岫也在，手里拎着两串烤物，哪边吃到一半也分不清。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng gěi tā kān jiālǐ sònglái de xìn , pángbiān yǒu yìshuāng huà dé géwài dà de xié , xiémiàn jīhū zhàn diào bànzhāng zhǐ , xiàmiàn de rén zhǐyǒu sānbǐ .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng showed him a letter from home, with an enormous drawing of a pair of shoes beside it. The uppers filled almost half the page; the person below took only three strokes.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡给他看家里送来的信，旁边有一双画得格外大的鞋，鞋面几乎占掉半张纸，下面的人只有三笔。

pairs.target: " tā shuō rén búyòng huà , jiàn guò . " ruǎn héng shuō , " xié méi jiàn guò de rén duō . "
pairs.english: “She says there's no need to draw people; we've seen them,” Ruan Heng said. “More people haven't seen the shoes.”
pairs.hanzi: “她说人不用画，见过。”阮衡说，“鞋没见过的人多。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ nàcì lùshang tiāo sīdài , rènzhēn kàn le kàn xié shàng huà chū de jié , méi shuō xiàng shénme . wēn xiù quèshuō zhōngyú zhǎodào bǐ dù chéng gèng huì huà gōu de rén , ruǎn héng biàn bǎ xìn shōuhuí qù , bùxǔ tā ná háizi de xié tóng huòxiāng bǐ .
pairs.english: Remembering the ribbons chosen on the road, Tavi studied the drawn bows without saying what they resembled. Wenxiu said they had finally found someone who drew hooks better than Du Cheng; Ruan Heng took the letter back, refusing to let her compare his child's shoes with a cargo carriage.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起那次路上挑丝带，认真看了看鞋上画出的结，没说像什么。温岫却说终于找到比杜澄更会画钩的人，阮衡便把信收回去，不许她拿孩子的鞋同货厢比。

pairs.target: huí diàn qián , tǎ wéi mǎi le yì xiǎozhāng báozhǐ , gěi nài lěi xiěxìn .
pairs.english: Before returning to the shop, Tavi bought a small sheet of thin paper to write to Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 回店前，塔维买了一小张薄纸，给奈蕾写信。

pairs.target: tā jiǎng tái jǐng de wūdǐng yǔ chuán dēng , yě jiǎng zìjǐ zài shí dēng chà huítóu rènlù zhīhòu , zhèhuí duō kànjiàn le nǎxiē yuánlái zhī zài tú shàng yìxiǎo diǎn lǐ de dōngxī , wèn tā ruò huàn yíjì zài zǒu , tōngcháng xiānchá shénme .
pairs.english: He described Moss Well's roofs and boat lamp, and what he had noticed this time in places formerly mere dots on the map after learning to look back at Stone Lamp Fork. He asked what she usually checked first when returning in another season.
pairs.hanzi: 他讲苔井的屋顶与船灯，也讲自己在石灯岔回头认路之后，这回多看见了哪些原来只在图上一小点里的东西，问她若换一季再走，通常先查什么。

pairs.target: tā jiāng xìn xiě hǎo , fù le yóufèi , jiāojìn kǎobǐng pù jiāngyào zhā kǒu de yóudài , méi wèn tā shénme shíhòu néng huí .
pairs.english: He finished the letter, paid postage and put it into the bakery mailbag about to be tied shut, without asking when she could reply.
pairs.hanzi: 他将信写好，付了邮费，交进烤饼铺将要扎口的邮袋，没问她什么时候能回。

pairs.target: lóushàng de chuāng tuīkāi , jiēbiān hái liàng zhe jǐzhǎn dēng , dōu shì zhào zhuōshàng chīshí de , búshì zài děng nǎ yímiàn qí fàng xiàlái .
pairs.english: Opening his upstairs window, he saw lamps still lit along the street, all lighting food on tables rather than waiting for any flag to fall.
pairs.hanzi: 楼上的窗推开，街边还亮着几盏灯，都是照桌上吃食的，不是在等哪一面旗放下来。

pairs.target: tā kào zài chuāng biān , zuǐlǐ shì zhe chuī nàduàn diàozi , dìyīshēng zhī chū le fēng . gébì ruǎn héng qiāo le yíxià qiáng , jiào tā míngzǎo zài xué , bié ràng zhěngcéng lóu yǐwéi yèlǐ yòu gāi qǐ bān .
pairs.english: Leaning by the window, he tried whistling the tune, but his first note was only air. Next door, Ruan Heng tapped the wall and told him to learn tomorrow morning, before the whole floor thought it was time for another night shift.
pairs.hanzi: 他靠在窗边，嘴里试着吹那段调子，第一声只出了风。隔壁阮衡敲了一下墙，叫他明早再学，别让整层楼以为夜里又该起班。
